build_tarsier_multimodal_model: build a Tarsier multimodal model for conditional generation with vision and language components
create_tarsier_processor: create a Tarsier processor that expands image tokens and tokenizes text with pixel values
create_tarsier_projector: create a Tarsier multimodal projector that maps vision features to text embedding space with two linear layers
init_tarsier_vision_tower: initialize a CLIP or Siglip vision tower for Tarsier with configurable feature layers and quantization
process_tarsier_multimodal_input: process Tarsier multimodal inputs by replacing image tokens with expanded token sequences based on image size
